title: self-healing-profile-annotator-and-autodraft-summaries
author: Claire Nguyen
description: Motivation: onboarding cadence has shown two recurring failure modes: (1) sparse or inconsistent profile metadata from external contributors and (2) low-signal automated changelog drafts that require heavy manual editing. This PR introduces a self-healing profile annotator that backfills missing fields using artifact provenance and lightweight inference, plus a contextual changelog autodrafter that synthesizes human-readable impact statements from profile diffs and telemetry. What changed: added a new annotator pipeline (annotator/self_heal_runner.py) that applies heuristics and confidence scoring to fix missing fields (model_alias, tokenizer_family, seq_len_hint) and emits a reconciliation record; introduced a sampling profiler (profiler/sampled_runner.go) that runs fast microworkloads to surface latency/p95 and token-throughput fingerprints; added a changelog writer (changelog/autodraft.py) that consumes diffs + sampled-profile summaries to assemble concise release bullets and suggested risk levels. Rollout plan: dark-run for 48 hours in onboarding sandbox, opt-in for curators via registry flag, then gradual enable for nightly batch. Fallbacks: annotator records proposed changes as draft annotations requiring curator approval; autodraft outputs are stored as draft notes with confidence scores. Tests and validation: end-to-end unit tests for metadata reconciliation, an integration fixture exercising sample workloads, and a small dataset used for profiling CI checks. Related work: builds on ENG-1937 (onboard heuristics) and ENG-2012 (changelog pipelines).

review_comments: Samir Desai (review): Can you add a short-circuit to skip backfill when provenance confidence < 0.4? The annotator should never overwrite explicit curator fields.
Author (Claire Nguyen): Good catch — added a confidence threshold and explicit curator-preserve guard. See annotator/self_heal_runner.py line 182 change.
Priya Kapoor (review): The sampled profiler seems to add ~200ms to our CI run; can we gate it behind a fixture flag so it only runs in profiling pipelines?
Author (Claire Nguyen): Moved heavy microworkloads behind profiler-fixture.yaml and added a lightweight CI-friendly path for unit tests.
Daniel Park (approval): Tested against three recent onboarding failures; annotations correctly propose backfills and the autodraft produced concise summaries. Approving pending CI green.
Security (comment): Ensure reconciliation table write patterns are parameterized to avoid SQL injection in rare artifact names.
Author (Claire Nguyen): SQL layer refactored to use prepared statements and parameter binding as requested.
Ops (comment): Recommend a runtime flag to disable autodraft writes during emergency migrations.
Author (Claire Nguyen): Added setup/feature_flags.yaml entry and documented the emergency flag in docs/onboard-curator-guide.md.

release_notes: - Add self-healing annotator to auto-propose missing model metadata and emit reconciliation records for curator approval; improves onboarding success rate; - Add sampled profiler to collect quick latency/p95 and throughput fingerprints during onboarding; used to auto-tag perf regressions; - Add changelog autodrafter that synthesizes concise release bullets and suggested risk levels from diffs + profiles; outputs drafts for curator review; - Feature gated (setup/feature_flags.yaml) and dark-run for 48h before wide rollout;
